articles.title: Italian jobs, French connections and Berlin walls: Chess’s European tour
articles.description: Sicily, Madrid, France and Berlin have all left their mark on chess vocabulary. The French Defence emerged from a 1834 correspondence match between Paris and London. Berlin Defence, meanwhile, was revived by Vladimir Kramnik in his 2000 world championship match against Garry Kasparov.
